POWER BI PROJECT

Financial Overview Dashboard

A reporting structure for understanding financial and operational performance.
Power BIFinancial ReportingDashboard DesignKPI Design

Tools & Technologies

  • Power BI
  • Power Query
  • DAX
  • Excel

My Role

  • Dashboard structure
  • KPI organization
  • Report design
  • Financial reporting layout

Project Overview

This dashboard brings revenue, profit, cost, and location measures into one reporting view. Its structure is designed to help users scan headline performance first, then move into the operational detail behind those figures.

What I Built

  • Financial overview with core measures
  • Revenue breakdown by business area
  • Operational cost reporting
  • Location-level performance view
  • Clear hierarchy for fast dashboard scanning
